2608.25325.title: FinRiskAtlas: Decision-Aligned Evaluation of Large Language Models for Financial Risk Review
2608.25325.paper_summary: Deploying large language models for professional financial review requires more than measuring general financial competence: models must perform the specific review operation required by a workflow and determine whether available evidence is sufficient for a defensible decision. Existing financial benchmarks cover knowledge, reasoning, compliance, and professional tasks, but their evaluation units are often organized around datasets or task formulations rather than the decisions that deployed systems support. We introduce FinRiskAtlas, a Chinese-language benchmark that evaluates financial LLMs along two complementary dimensions: operation execution under fixed evidence states and evidence-state control under evolving review conditions. The static benchmark contains 9,742 instances across 53 task families, including 42 Domain Knowledge families and eleven downstream review operations defined by explicit evaluation contracts. FinRisk-Ask extends this framework through offline replay of 680 pre-action states from 104 de-identified professional trajectories, withholding future evidence during inference and using it only to construct expert-verified evidence targets. Across 33 model configurations, operation-level evaluation yields non-redundant rankings (mean pairwise Spearman correlation 0.42 across downstream operations), and knowledge-based shortlisting can incur up to 18.01 points of regret on individual operations. FinRisk-Ask further shows that entering the Ask branch more frequently does not necessarily improve request targeting or end-to-end evidence acquisition. These results show that broad financial capability scores do not fully capture where models are reliable in professional workflows, motivating evaluation units aligned with the decisions and evidence states that deployed systems must support.
2608.25325.paper_summary_zh: 部署大型語言模型以進行專業金融審查不僅需要衡量一般的金融能力：模型必須執行工作流程所需的特定審查操作，並確定可用證據是否足以做出有根據的決策。現有的金融基準涵蓋知識、推理、合規性和專業任務，但其評估單元通常圍繞數據集或任務公式組織，而不是已部署系統所支持的決策。我們介紹了 FinRiskAtlas，一個評估金融 LLM 的中文基準，從兩個互補的維度進行評估：在固定證據狀態下的操作執行和在不斷變化的審查條件下的證據狀態控制。靜態基準包含 9,742 個實例，涵蓋 53 個任務家族，包括 42 個領域知識家族和由明確評估合同定義的十一個下游審查操作。FinRisk-Ask 通過離線重播來自 104 條去識別專業軌跡的 680 個預操作狀態來擴展此框架，在推理過程中保留未來證據，並僅用於構建專家驗證的證據目標。在 33 種模型配置中，操作級評估產生了非冗餘的排名（下游操作的平均成對斯皮爾曼相關係數為 0.42），而基於知識的短名單在個別操作上可能會產生高達 18.01 分的遺憾。FinRisk-Ask 進一步顯示，進入 Ask 分支的頻率增加並不一定改善請求定位或端到端證據獲取。這些結果表明，廣泛的金融能力分數並未完全捕捉模型在專業工作流程中可靠的地方，這促使我們設計與已部署系統必須支持的決策和證據狀態對齊的評估單元。
